market_summary: During the London/NY overlap, US equity indices show clear bullish expansion with US100 reclaiming VWAP and breaking out above Value Area High backed by RVOL > 2.0. Conversely, Gold and Bitcoin remain in persistent downtrends below their daily VWAP and VAL, but both are currently overextended into primary support levels (XAUUSD stalling directly on Put Wall #1 and BTCUSD stretched beneath its -2 ATR envelope), warranting patience. EURUSD is consolidating inside its value area with neutral delta.

signals.rationale: Price is trading well below VAL (3941.56) and below POC (3978.00). CVD is -9.04 (BEARISH) with negative slope (-1.12), aligning with heavy downward momentum. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price remains far below VWAP (3955.11) and EMA50 (3946.23). Candles are pushing below the lower ATR band (3898.89), reflecting aggressive expansion backed by previous yellow RVOL spikes. GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING below Gamma Flip (3921.28). However, live price (3870.59) is directly stalling right on Put Wall #1 (3870.26) and severely extended after breaking Session Low (3882.79). Selling directly into Put Wall #1 with extreme ATR extension carries severe mean-reversion risk.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below declining VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection of Put Wall #1 after breaking Session Low

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10808 to VAH 1.10976) and below POC (1.10928). CVD is +2036.04 (NEUTRAL) with flat/positive slope, diverging from the current downward price thrust. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is below VWAP (1.10867) and EMA50 (1.10888). Forming bar has pushed under the lower ATR band (1.10732). RVOL on the last closed bar was 1.535 (no yellow spike > 2.0). Price is currently testing immediate support near S/R 1.10710 and Session Low (1.10662). Due to conflicting neutral CVD and lack of breakout volume confirmation inside the value area, entering short is unconfirmed.
signals.level_event: breakdown below Prev Low 1.10824 toward S/R 1.10710

signals.rationale: Price has broken out above VAH (28198.89) and POC (28119.65). CVD is -2.92 (NEUTRAL) with positive short-term slope (+0.97). Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price reclaimed both VWAP (28117.18) and EMA50 (28122.28) with strong structural thrust. Candles are expanding along the upper ATR band (28256.69), confirmed by an RVOL > 2.0 spike (2.396). GEX regime is POSITIVE_DAMPENING above Gamma Flip (28157.93). Live price (28231.17) cleanly accepts above prior resistance turned support at S/R 28209.17 with plenty of upside room toward Call Wall #1 (28428.25).
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish above rising VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is trading well below VAL (73021.39) and far below POC (73522.50). CVD is -0.09 (BEARISH) with negative slope (-0.03), agreeing with the strong downtrend. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is heavily trending below declining VWAP (73234.83) and EMA50 (73106.53). Candles are riding beneath the lower ATR band (71972.83). While volume expanded, the last bar RVOL was 1.897 (sub-2.0), and the forming candle is stretched far below the ATR envelope after sweeping Session Low (71491.70) down to 71191.90. Chasing live price (71463.10) mid-bar at extreme ATR extension without a pullback carries high risk of a snapback squeeze.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below descending VWAP and EMA50
